title: Context and memory in an agent

items.stem: A student chats with your makerspace assistant on Monday and comes back on Thursday for a new session. Your program saved nothing between the two sessions. What can the model see on Thursday?

options.text: Only the text your program sends it in the new session
Monday's chat, because the model keeps what it has read
A short summary of Monday that the model writes itself
Monday's chat, but only the student's own messages

items.stem: Call 1 sends 1,000 tokens (instructions, tools and the question). The model replies with a 40-token tool request, and the tool returns a 300-token result. Call 2 sends everything so far, and the model replies with a 30-token tool request whose tool returns a 500-token result. Call 3 again sends everything so far. How many tokens does call 3 send?

Your 150,000-token set of manuals is pasted into the system prompt, and each student question takes 4 model calls. The sponsor says the cost is too high. Which change cuts the cost the most while still answering from the manuals?

options.text: Switch to a model with a larger window so it fits easily
Summarize the whole conversation once the answer is given
Give a search tool that loads only the pages it needs
Save the manuals into a note file that is read every call

items.stem: Your assistant saves a note for each student, such as "soldering: trained". Name one extra piece of information to write in every note so the assistant can tell later whether it is still trustworthy.
Which item belongs in a saved note that the assistant reads at the start of each new session, rather than in a search over the manuals?

options.text: The 60-page operating guide for the vinyl cutter
Which machines a given student has passed training on
The makerspace's opening hours, which never change
The text of the assistant's standing instructions
